# St. Mary Seminary

> St. Mary Seminary in Wickliffe, Ohio offers priestly formation and theological education through its Program of Priestly Formation and graduate programs for current students and continuing education seekers.

Founded in 1848 by Bishop Amadeus Rappe, St. Mary Seminary is an accredited institution affiliated with the Diocese of Cleveland and the Association of Theological Schools. The seminary serves candidates for priesthood and offers Master of Arts in Theology and continuing education programs.
